result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one clear rendering defect stands out: the delivery time and fee text overlaps on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, making both unreadable. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ("25–35 min") and the delivery fee text ("€0 delivery") are rendered on top of each other in the same line, so both are garbled and unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the flex or inline layout so the delivery time and fee sit on separate lines or in separate containers with proper spacing, and make sure the text wraps instead of overlapping when space is tight.
